title: Function definition tool manifest
description: Canonical schema for a function-definition package's tools.yaml (see contracts/function-definition/TEMPLATE/tools.yaml). Additive v1 contract: every function package's tools.yaml is validated against this file by services/registry/validate_package.py. Coordination rule: this path is authored once (first-to-land wins) and is never duplicated by a competing schema elsewhere.

tools.description: Every tool this function definition is permitted to call. An empty list is not permitted — a function with no tools should omit tools.yaml only if the package contract ever allows it, which it currently does not.

name.description: Stable snake_case tool identifier, unique within this manifest.

description.description: What the tool does and any scoping notes, in plain language.

permissions.description: Coarse permission class the orchestrator enforces. read-only may not mutate any system of record.

scope.description: Optional narrowing note (e.g. an MCP server name, an allow-listed host, a dataset).
